name: Call of Heresy
notes: In game (hwp_pri_call_of_heresy, tested): any enemy death on the floor rolls an intact body (3/4/6/8/10%, Deeper Depravity adds to elites and bosses); the body lasts 60 s, glows green on your screen only. Heresy is its own stack: +8/10/12/14/16% risen damage per stack; each stack adds 2/2/3/3/3% to the lunge roll on a body within 40: a 3 s devour, rooted and silenced, +50 health regeneration a second, the body gone. The HUD icon swaps at 5 Heresy. Heresy carries across floors (with the risen) and resets in town. plan-forgemaster 20261022-102006, plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-084131. Assumed: the 40 lunge range, the 60 s body, the glow art. Heresy is its own stack, not negative Favor: normal raise +1, elite +2, boss +3; at 5 Heresy you can't raise. Raising is blocked only once you're at 5 or more, so an elite or boss raised at 3-4 Heresy can take you past 5 (a boss at 4 makes 7). Heresy's buff icon swaps at 5+ (raising blocked) to a different one: one stack whose icon changes, not two stacks. Heresy carries from floor to floor and resets in town. It goes down only through Sacrificial Penance (Necrotic Resurrection at 5 Favor) and the Pyre Sacrifice orb. Lunge: rolled once per intact body, the first time you come within range of it. You suddenly lunge at it and consume its flesh: a 3 s channel that cancels whatever you're casting and blocks all abilities until it ends, and uses up the body. While you eat, your health regeneration rises by 50 per second. Choosing the spec gives Divine Favor level 1 for free. An intact body is a gray version of the enemy lying on its side (a boss's stands upright, gray). Bodies stay on the ground for 60 s. Level numbers are a first pass.
summary: Slain enemies have a chance to fall with their body intact, ready for Necrotic Resurrection. Heresy, gained by raising the dead, stacks up: each stack makes your summons stronger, but raises the chance that you lunge at an intact body you come near and consume its flesh, a 3 s channel that cancels and blocks all your abilities but gives +50 health regeneration per second while it lasts.
